is_comment_sound.instructions: This unit is a definition with the comments it owns. Find the worst comment and choose the one option that best describes it. Choose sound only when every comment fits it.

criteria.sound: Every comment states what this code does - or why, when the code cannot say it - in the code's own words, and nothing else.
criteria.contradicted: A comment claims something the code shown does not do: a wrong count, a part the code does not contain, a different order, or return, error, or validation behavior the code does not have.
criteria.wording_unmapped: A comment uses coined labels, nicknames, or value judgments (honest, clean, proper) for parts of this code, so its nouns map to no identifier or behavior.
criteria.about_surroundings: A comment describes who calls this code, when it is called, what a caller does with the result, or where else its output goes.
criteria.historical: A comment refers to a past state, a rename, an old version, or contrasts this code with a design that is not shown (never a second X, no longer, instead of the old Y).
